lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Honey♡♡♡ Are you up?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I enjoyed our date yesterday :)
Sorry, but I can't remember much.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm not surprised.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You drank quite a bit.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: It's possible that you're spreading yourself too thin.
Do you remember anything that happened?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Of course, I remember everything. Hehe!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I nearly couldn't get out of bed this morning

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: thanks to last night.
Why?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: It was my first time,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: so I wanted to take a break,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: but you were feeling so good,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: that you wouldn't let me.
What?!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Not that I didn't like it.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I was just a little taken aback, that's all.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I kept saying that I couldn't take much more,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: but you kept reassuring me that you'd take care of everything...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: You really can't remember anything?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Yesterday, after we were done eating,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: you took me back to your room, and we had some drinks. After that, we...

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: we played that game all night. What was it called again?
Wait just a second.
I quickly check the activity log for Final Quest.
It shows that I was logged in all night.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hehehe. Surprised?
You could say that.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm just a beginner, so I'm not that skilled,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: but you kept cheering me on, even though I kept dying.
I don't usually do that.
I'm usually much better at that game.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Wow, really?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I've never seen you so happy.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Even though video games aren't usually my thing,

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm more than happy

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: to play with you once in a while.
That'd be nice.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Great!

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Come to think of it, you didn't get much sleep last night.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Aren't you tired?
Nothing I can't manage.
I'm fine. What about you?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: That's good :)

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: I'm a bit tired

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: so I was planning on taking the day off.
Ok. Rest up.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Will do. My hips are super sore too.
... All we did was play video games, right?

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: viper
lines.text: See you later♡
